text: Amara has her second interview at the council sometime next week. Nervous, keeps saying she bombed the first one. Text her good luck the night before.

Hassan into fly fishing now, ties his own flies, goes up to the Tweed whenever he can get a weekend. Wife Dalia thinks it's a phase lol. He's eyeing a new reel, a Hardy something, way over budget, might be one to remember when his birthday comes round in early spring. Their kids think it's hilarious.
jamal's mum in hospital again, hip. he's going up to leeds end of the month to stay w her

Met Aoife's partner Matteo for the first time at the pub. Lovely guy, plays bass in a covers band, gig at the Crown early March, and they rehearse in his mate's garage every Thursday. Aoife said they're going to Sicily over the summer to see his family, his nonna is turning 90 while they're there. Aoife's a bit nervous about meeting them all.
Rachel applied for the head of design role at Bianchi & Co. hears back end of the month. Ask her afterwards how it went
so Sofia said um her brother Alfie got into the under 16s county squad, first match is the Saturday after half term and she's super proud
Pick up stamps, return the library books before Thursday, book the MOT sometime next week
isla - knitting a blanket for her sister's baby, due early march. loves chunky merino. she'd go mad for a yarn voucher
Aleksander Popescu called about the warehouse manager job. Interview is the 4th, then a practical task the day after. Must send him the notes I made on their safety stuff before then.
Jaya's dad retired last Friday after 32 years at the railway. Big do for him that evening, she said he cried in the speech.
Deepa's wedding is off. She and Kwame split in August, she only told me today. Check in on her this weekend, maybe take her for brunch.
Dana collects vinyl, mostly 70s soul. Hunting for an original pressing of What's Going On. Birthday's in early December.

Ethan started at the bank Monday. Says his manager's a nightmare already, micromanages everything, and he's wondering if he made a mistake leaving the old place. His girlfriend Kerry is doing her nursing exams the week after and she's barely sleeping. I should take him for a pint end of next week, see how he's getting on.
tobi's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, came home that evening groggy but fine
Note to self: Laila mentioned she's a massive Arsenal fan, season ticket since she was 12, sits with her uncle. Don't bring up Spurs lol
Grace's son Yaw has a trumpet recital on the 14th and she's dreading it more than he is. I said I'd come. Afterwards they're going for pizza.
Efua is applying for the PhD in Edinburgh, deadline end of November. Her mum wants her to stay in London. I should send her that funding list Vikram shared.
Vikram and his wife are doing the London marathon in April, training like mad. He runs, she cycles alongside lol
Remind me to ring Bogdan on Thursday to ask how the interview at the airport went. It was this morning and he wasn't feeling it.
Ali told me his brother Malik is moving to Dubai sometime next month for a job with an engineering firm. Their mum's not taking it well.
Erin, coeliac, don't do the pasta thing again. Also hates coriander.
Mandla is building a model railway in the loft, full Hornby set up, his grandad's old engines. Wants a new transformer for christmas, apparently the old one keeps tripping.

Hugo's interview with the NHS trust got cancelled, they pulled the role two days before. Gutted. He's looking at agency stuff now, and his wife Sofia reckons he should go freelance. He's got a call with a recruiter sometime next week, then a coffee with an old colleague the day after. Feeling pretty flat about it all.

Lin's daughter starts reception in September, they're touring schools over the next few weeks, applications due mid January. Lin's partner wants the catholic one, Lin doesn't, so that's a fun dinner table topic. Daughter mainly cares which one has a guinea pig.
Had coffee w Amara. Got the job!! Starts first week of Jan. Card + something fizzy.
Kwame said his sister Kerry is having her baby shower the Sunday after next. I'm doing cake. Need to ask what flavour, she said she can't stand lemon at the moment.
Matteo plays Warhammer every Tuesday at the shop on Mill Lane. Painting a whole Ultramarines army, like 80 models. Wants an airbrush eventually.

Ok voice note. Rachel rang, her mum's having the knee replacement on the 9th, and Rachel's taking a week off to look after her, so the day before she'll drive down, and then she said the week after she'll be back at work but working from home. She's exhausted honestly, the job hunt plus this. I should drop round with a lasagne once her mum's settled, and text her the morning of the op.
dalia - new job at the museum, archivist, starts 1st nov. so chuffed for her

Jaya's going to Lagos for her cousin's wedding over Christmas. Flying out the 20th, back the 3rd. First time back in six years so she's excited but a bit anxious, her grandma's not been well. Her husband Yaw can't get the time off so she's taking the kids on her own, and the wedding itself is the day after they land. Ask her how it all went once she's back.
Isla said Hassan's knee is bad again, physio twice a week. Probably no five a side till spring.
Sofia's mum turns 70 at the end of the month. Sofia's organising a surprise lunch the Saturday before. Asked if I could chip in for a necklace, reply by Friday.
gym, dentist tues 3pm, then sort car insurance renewal
Aoife Gonzalez (Fifi to everyone at work) finally handed her notice in. Last day the 30th, leaving drinks that evening at the Fox. She's interviewing at two agencies next week.
Talked to Deepa about the half marathon. She's doing Cardiff in early October next year, wants to beat 2 hours. Running club Wednesdays.
Malik Usman, 'Mal', reads nothing but fantasy. Halfway through Wheel of Time for the third time. Wants the Sanderson leather editions.
Kerry's little boy has his tonsils out next Wednesday. She's taking him in that morning, back home the day after if all's ok. Message her Thursday to see how he is.
Just a thought, need to update my CV before the end of the month, and apply for the Lewis Partners job before they close it.
Ethan's parents have their 40th anniversary in early April. He and his sister Grace are planning a trip to Lake Como for them. Ethan wants me to look at hotels.

Bogdan into chess properly now, rated about 1600 online, plays at a club on Fridays above the Red Lion. Tournament in Reading sometime next month, his first rated one. His son plays too and apparently already beats him. Bogdan wants a proper wooden board and clock, been hinting about it for weeks.
Yaw got into the Royal Academy junior programme!! Grace told me at pickup. Starts in January, Saturdays.

Laila is struggling with the job search, 40 applications and only one interview, which is at Kim Associates on Monday. She's convinced she'll mess it up. Text her Sunday night and maybe call the day after to hear how it went.
Hugo and his wife are hosting thanksgiving this year, end of November, he's American lol. His in laws flying in from Boston the week before.
aleksander's daughter has her grade 5 piano exam soon, he's more nervous than she is
Vikram mentioned his aunt passed away on Sunday. Funeral is sometime next week in Birmingham. I should send a card to him and his mum.
Erin and her girlfriend Lin just got a kitten, called Pickle. Lin's allergic but taking tablets apparently
Dana is going for a promotion to team lead, panel interview on the 18th, presentation the day before to her director. Must ask her about it after.
Efua's brother Alfie graduates from Manchester in mid-July. Whole family going up. She's sorting the hotel.
Jamal got the Williams account manager job after all, they called him back the day after the rejection. Mad. Starting sometime next week.
Mandla says his wife Amara wants to learn pottery, there's a wheel course at the community centre starting early February. Might be a good Christmas present for her if he books it.
Hassan's son Ali has his driving test on Friday, third attempt. Hassan says he's a wreck. Wish Ali luck Thursday.

Tobi was talking for ages about his crochet, he's doing amigurumi now, made a whole set of Pokemon for his nephews and they fight over Pikachu. Selling them at the craft fair end of November, setting up the stall the night before. His mum does the knitted stuff next to him. Don't forget to go and buy something, maybe a Snorlax.
Rachel called, nothing major, just catching up. Weather's been awful.
Isla's interview at the BBC went well apparently, second round is early December. Her dad works there too, which is awkward. Ask her the next day how round two went.
Grace's mum moved into the care home last weekend. Grace is finding it hard, visits every evening after work. Pop round sometime this week, bring biscuits.
Kwame MacDonald plays rugby for the vets on Sundays. Broke his finger two weeks ago, still playing. His wife Efua is furious.
Sofia: her partner Hugo got made redundant Friday. Meeting with HR the next morning about the package. Sofia's trying to stay positive. Check in with them both end of the week.
Dalia's book club is doing Middlemarch this month, she's loving it. Her sister Jaya joined too and hates it lol
Ethan mentioned Kerry's 30th is the week after his brother's stag, mid-March. He wants to do something low key, she'd love a spa day, he said. Don't forget to ask him the plan.

Long call with Deepa. She's got an interview for the senior pharmacist post at St Mary's, on the 7th. Her brother Vikram is driving her that morning. She's been off work stressed since the summer so this is a big deal. Remind me to text her the night before, and maybe send flowers a week after whatever happens.
